title: How-to guides audit
description:
Verify every CLI/storage/structure/semantics claim in `docs/how-to/` against current source and fix all drift class-wide.

## Background

`docs/how-to/` (10 files — `adopt-planning-bracket.md`, `custom-gates.md`, `dependency-management.md`, `deployment.md`, `knowledge-work.md`, `multi-agent-coordination.md`, `research-projects.md`, `software-development.md`, `troubleshooting.md`, `validation-rules.md`; 4,452 lines) is one of the disjoint-footprint areas in an exhaustive, source-verified documentation audit covering the whole adopter-facing documentation surface. Recurring drift classes to sweep for include invented CLI surface, stale storage-format specifics, over-credited guarantees, legacy or future narration, and prerequisite/environment drift.

A known-benign box-drawing occurrence exists at `dependency-management.md:139-140,419`: it is verbatim CLI output, not a hand-drawn diagram, and stays as plain text (the carve-out) rather than converting to Mermaid.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every documented command and flag in `docs/how-to/` exists in the current generated CLI schema or the current clap definitions.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every repository-relative link, heading anchor, source citation, and addressable-item citation in `docs/how-to/` resolves.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every diagram-shaped block in `docs/how-to/` is Mermaid; directory trees and verbatim command output are not diagrams.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every factual claim in `docs/how-to/` about CLI behavior, storage layout, repository structure, or engine semantics matches the current source tree; where a drift instance is found, its whole class is swept across the footprint, not patched line-by-line.
- [hard] REQ-05: Prose in `docs/how-to/` states current behavior only — no legacy or future/roadmap narration remains.
- [hard] REQ-06: Every volatile fact in `docs/how-to/` with an existing projection or citation surface is projected or cited rather than hand-copied; each volatile fact with no such surface is cited to its source file and recorded for follow-up filing.

## Notes

The linked plan document carries the exact check commands and expected outputs (§2).

CLI-surface verification must use a binary built from the current HEAD; a stale installed binary has previously produced false verification results. The generated CLI schema under-reports the real flag surface (clap `visible_alias` flag forms and the global flags are absent from it), so a documented flag absent from the schema is checked against the clap definitions in `crates/jit/src/cli.rs` before being declared invented; only a flag absent from both is a defect.

A doc in this footprint found wholly obsolete or redundant may be deleted or merged into another, with the rationale recorded on this task. Every inbound link tree-wide is repointed in the same change — links are uniformly relative markdown, so inbound references are findable by filename in both bare-name and relative-path forms — and no doc is removed before its inbound links are repointed. After any deletion or merge, every link and anchor tree-wide still resolves.

Blast radius: self-contained to `docs/how-to/` unless a delete/merge triggers the rule above.
